Inmobilia

A Mérida-based developer of large planned communities whose Tulum presence centres on Tulum 101, a master-planned district of residential, hospitality and mixed-use projects.

  • Master-planned communities
  • Residential lots and macro-lots
  • Branded and hotel-linked residences
  • Mixed-use and commercial districts
  • Golf communities

SIMCA

A southeast-Mexico developer with residential, industrial and retail divisions, active in Tulum through condominium projects in Aldea Zamá, La Veleta and the Tulum 101 master plan.

  • Residential condominiums
  • Residential lot subdivisions
  • Industrial and logistics parks
  • Retail and commercial space
  • Property management and vacation rentals

03

TAO México

TAO México is a Riviera Maya-born developer of residential communities, with completed and ongoing projects in Tulum, Akumal and Puerto Aventuras and newer work in Puerto Vallarta and Los Cabos.

  • Residential communities in the Riviera Maya
  • Jungle and nature-integrated living
  • Condominiums, homes and residential lots
  • Integrated design, construction and property management
  • Pacific coast expansion (Puerto Vallarta, Los Cabos)

Grupo R4 Yucatán

A Yucatán Peninsula developer with residential projects in Yucatán and Quintana Roo, including three condominium buildings in Tulum's Aldea Zamá area.

  • Residential condominiums
  • Residential lots and homes
  • Architectural design and construction
  • Urbanisation and landscaping
  • Mixed-use development
